content: Haruanga Babuna Mana Taunga Yaungam Sabanga
Yesu baladi haruanga babung teladi muli. Harua ba,
“Long Xaiya Yonggaxinoa bila li. Xaitamoxi tela xauxau taunga yaungam sabanga mana garang luba.
Xauxau masup, baing soxi lipuxing oxatamdi mala rangua lipuadi xusungadi ba dima ba, bu duwagidi ma. Ne hauxading!
“Baing soxi lipu oxatam teladi muli mala bu dibaladi ba, ‘Taunga xauxau masup ba. Bapalodi xaung kau dungmanangandi ditutudi masup, axadi daxauxau ba. Ama yaunga taungania.’
“Ne lipudi xusungadi ba dima ba, dahatumia te saing dila dituxu ding oxatadingdi. Tela ila umangia, tela ila mana sianging oxatanoa.
Teladi dituxu uleginamdi, dilibu doa manadi saing dungdi mati.
Xaitamoxi atin disala haringina, saing soxi lipuxing haungingamdi mala bu dahanggalangia lipu ungingamgadi ba xaung bu ditung yabadinga.
“Baing bala lipuxing oxatamdi ba, ‘Yaunga taunganoa xauxau ba, ne lipudi ngaxusungadi ba dima ba, ding lipu xaidi te ba dima.
Ala mana daxanga soking longgalo, saing axusunga lipu gaxarea abagudi ba dima yaunga taungania.’
Binabu lipu oxatamdi dila mana daxangadi saing daxap lipu gaxarea dibagudi, lipu xaidi xaung lipu diandi, saing dima dirung numa xangingamia saing baxagi sibuna.
“Ne bungina xaitamoxi luxu ma bu bagu lipudi, bagu lipu tela sau yauyaunga yaungam te bila lipudi disau xaidap yaungamia.
Xusunga ba, ‘Riagu, usau yauyaunga yaungamdi te. Uluxu ma baru?’ Ne lipua ba haruangan te.
“Baing xaitamoxi bala lipu taunga oxatanamdi ba, ‘Agoxi kindi rimandi, saing ating mala sabasabia, labiania, longga lipudi ditang haringina saing digaxu waidingdi.’ ”
Baing Yesu harua ba, “Alungu to. Urana wagi lipu xumana, ne mogu taining tainina ing ganina ba diluxu ma.”
Xusunganga Mana Digim Gabman Takisindi
Baing Parisidi dila digugunia bu dahau hatumingua ba dilibu Yesu harua haruanga tela sanga ba disu haruanga mana.

Disoxi lipuxidingdi dinaxu manadi digabu Herot bakbaging teladi mala bu digugunia rangua. Daharua ba, “Lipu Tubatubaingam, am gaxabia ba ung lipu haruanga maxunama. Utubatuba Urana daxanganoa xaung haruanga maxuna, saing uhatum xumana mana lipudi hatumingadinga te. Ulibu hasusu mana lipu longgalo, heku lipu yayamdi kimbo lipu yaya teguamdi.
Tauna, ubaxanga nam. Maring mana tagim takis mala na Sisa,
kimbo doa? Uhatum baru?”
Ne Yesu xabia hatumingading diana saing harua ba, “Ang lipu manang luwadi! Baruta atuba ba atuxu murak manga?
Ahatanga siang mukiring tela nanga agim mala na Sisa.” Daxap Rom siang mukiring tela ma,
baing xusungadi ba, “Gaxarea babunoa li? Gaxarea yanoa wa mana?”
Dahaxuya ba, “Sisa naga.” Baing harua nadi ba, “Tauna, axadi Sisa iniadi, asinadi na Sisa, saing axadi Urana iniadi, asinadi na Urana.”
Dilungu haruanga baguba, baing dihixi mana. Baing disauya dilauba.
Xusunganga Mana Lipuadi Dimati Dimesa Muli
Mana xaidapka baguba gugunianga Sadyusi
telamdi dima rangua Yesu bu duxusunga mana axamang tela. Ding dahatiam mana lipudi bagula dimesa muli.

Daharua ba, “Lipu Tubatubaingam, Moses bung Urana Xuania ba, ‘Nabu lipu tela mati garang tate, bing kixinginoa bagula yau sabanganoa tabinoa bu tang daxap garadi masok, saking sabanganoa bakbagindi bagula disup te.’
Tauna, bunging tela neng sabangang 7 duwa liwe mam. Mugamugangama yau saing mati garang tate, binabu kixinginoa yau tabinoa.
Luwa xaung hiliadinga kubolu taininau, ila ila laing disup.
Baing ina naga, hainga mati.
Tauna, kimuya, bungina lipudi dimesa muli, bing haingga ba bagula wa gaxarea haininoa sibuna? Namua na 7 ding diyau ba.”
Yesu haxuya ba, “Hatumingaimdi didoa, namua na axabia Urana Xuanoa te xaung haringinganoa.
Bungina lipudi dimesa muli, bagula lup haing diyau ding te. Bila balau bagula duwa bila Urana uleginamdi duwa long xaiya.

Ne mana haruangua mana lipudi dimesa muli—ngabo ba ngaxusungang to. Atiti Urana Xuanoa harua mana axa ba, ne baruta ahatumia te? Kimu sibuna mana mugangaradi Ebraham, Aisak xaung Yekop tung dimati ba, Urana harua ba,
‘Ngawa Urana mana Ebraham, Urana mana Aisak, xaung Urana mana Yekop.’
Binabu ina Urana mana lipu matiandi te. Tegu. Ina Urana mana lipu gamatandi.”
Burangadi dilungu haruanganoa, baing dihixi mana tubatubainganoa.
Urana Hanaunaungang Mugamugangam
Bungina Parisidi dilungu ba Yesu libu Sadyusidi dimumguti, bing digugunia bu dituba muli.
Dingia tela xabia hanaunaungua xai sibuna. Baing tuba Yesu mana xusunganga baguli:
“Lipu Tubatubaingam, hanaunaunga Urana sina na Moses baruamta mugamuga?”
Yesu haxuya ba, “ ‘Bing ung murum sibuna mana Toxoratamona, Urana ungia, mana gamom longgalo xaung lum longgalo xaung hatumingam longgalo.’
Hanaunaunga baguli sabanga, xaung mugamugangam sibuna.
Baing luwa bing bila mugamugangama: ‘Bing ung murum sibuna mana riam longgalo bila ung murum sibuna maung.’
Hanaunaunga luwa li bing namuxina mana hanaunaunga longgalo Moses bung xaung mana haruanga longgalo Urana lipuxing suxunguxunguamdi dibung.”
Gaxarea Garanoa Kristo?
Parisidi diguguniauyu taxiya Yesu, baing xusungadi ba,
“Ahatum baru mana Urana Lipuxing Mogunganama? Gaxarea garanoa?” Dahaxuya ba, “Xaitamoxi Debit Garanoa.”
Harua nadi ba, “Tauna, baruta Urana Aningonoa sina hatuminga na Debit, saing Debit uxu lipua ba ‘Toxoratamona’? Namua na Debit harua ba,

content.text: “Urung kabukabu yayam wa rimagu rimamo rubinia,

content: Nabu Debit uxu ba ‘Toxoratamona,’ bing ina wa Debit garanoa xauna baru?”
Dingia tela sanga ba haxuya Yesu haruanganoa te. Baing kimuya mana bungina baguba, lipu longgalo dimaxuwa mana dituba mana xusunganga tela muli.

footnotes.text: Sisa yaya tela mana xaitamoxi sabanga Rom dingia. Wa etua mana xaitamoxidi.
Sadyusi bing Yuda sabungading sabungam tela, xan tela mana Parisidi.
Ebraham, Aisak, Yekop tung dimati mugau sibuna mana bungina Moses bung haruanga baguba, binabu mana Yesu haruanganoa hatanga ba tung aningodingdi duwauyu Urana maxania.
